meta.title: 6 small ways to romanticise your everyday life

beats.text: Six small ways to romanticise your ordinary, everyday life.
One. Turn a routine into a ritual. The same coffee, made slowly, with full attention.
Two. Put the phone down and actually notice — the light, the sound, the person in front of you.
Three. Give your day a soundtrack. Music turns a commute into a scene.
Four. Keep one beautiful thing in sight. Fresh flowers, a good view, a line you love.
Five. Do small tasks with care instead of rushing through them to get to 'real life'.
Six. Treat yourself as the main character. Decide, on purpose, that your day means something.
You don't need a different life to feel wonder. Usually you just need to pay closer attention to this one.

source_note: Save this for a dull Tuesday.
